arrott.interpretation: Competing exchange interactions at low temperature, source attribution.

exchange_model.scope: Conditional model estimates; Z=4 agreement is evidence used for a proposed cluster motif, not a directly measured cluster population.

proposed_inclusion_model.classification: author-proposed structural interpretation, not observed atomistic coordinates
proposed_inclusion_model.charge_compensation: Three Zn(II) ions removed per pair of Cr(III) ions.
proposed_inclusion_model.source_thermodynamic_rationale: Cr(III) d3 half-filled t2g favors octahedral coordination; compatible anion packing can accommodate an inclusion without a strong host-lattice shift.

source_particle_count_estimates.possible_clusters: Two tetramers or four dimers, as model possibilities.
At most one pair, as model estimate.

limits: Authors state the model is hard to prove; TEM/PXRD cannot directly establish inclusion size/location.
No measurable ZnCr2Se4 impurity reflection is identified. Figure5 is an illustration.
An alternative stochastic/surface distribution is discussed; magnetic evidence alone cannot fully exclude smaller clusters.
A bulk CdCr2Se4 peritectoid threshold below885°C and Cd:Cr ratios below64% are cited analogy, not this QD synthesis condition.
